3rd - Gersh 11/14/2025 11:22 PM
So the island they're currently on used to be a prospering kingdom known for the rich minerals and strong iron in the mountains on the North-East side of the island. With A kind green dragon that cared for the forest that separated the civilization from the mountains. Until one day a dark celestial Vrock came from the sky and made a nest in the mountains. Basically the nest started to spread darkness and decay through the land and rotted it's usefulness. The Dragon tried to stop it but lost in the fight and was corrupted, instead of the powers of life and growth it had the dragon returned to it's kobold civilization with new toxic powers. The kobolds loyal to their dragon leader however, saw it as a sign of power they harnessed the acidity from the green fog it emits from it's mouth now and turned it to a religion. Slowly the kobolds over time degreaded their once aqua blue scales to a near neon green, almost radiating the color. They continued to do as the corrupted dragon lord wished and went to war with the human kingdom, pillaging their farms and spreading the toxic waste from the dragon to their farmlands as religious practice. So now the kingdom is in trouble because they're starving and constantly at risk of another kobold raid. The King is a drunk because the loss of his wife and his son is incompetent so it's up to the crew to save the island from pure darkness.
